info.name: Gazebo - RBAC Users
info.description:
# Gazebo RBAC Users

Cognito identity + Django grant matrix for Production / Warehouse / Admin.

**Tables:** `rbac_user` (+ `photo_key`), `rbac_user_department`, `rbac_production_access`, `rbac_warehouse_access`, `rbac_admin_access`, `rbac_audit_event`

**Photos:** private objects in `gazebo-media-files` at `User-profile/{cognito_sub}/…`; APIs return short-lived `photo_url` (presigned GET), never a public URL.

## Base URL
`{{base_url}}` = `http://127.0.0.1:8000`

## Auth
1. Run **Login** (`POST /auth/login/`) — public
2. Copy `data.id_token` into `{{id_token}}` (or use the Login test script)
3. All other routes need `Authorization: Bearer {{id_token}}`
4. Admin write + audit list APIs need **any** Admin area grant

## Envelope
Success: `{ "status": "success", "message": "...", "data": ... }`
Error: `{ "status": "error", "message": "...", "data": null }`

## Vars
`{{base_url}}`, `{{id_token}}`, `{{user_id}}`

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Public login + signed-in self profile + own photo upload.

**Routes:** `POST /auth/login/`, `GET /auth/me/`, `POST /auth/me/photo/`

**Vars:** `{{id_token}}`

request.description:
### Login

`POST /auth/login/`

Public sign-in. Exchange username (or email) and password for Cognito tokens. Floor staff use badge usernames with no email. Copy `data.id_token` into `{{id_token}}` for later calls.

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `username` | yes* | Cognito username (e.g. `amit01`) |
| `email` | yes* | Alternative to username |
| `password` | yes | Password |

\* Provide `username` **or** `email`.

### Headers

| Header | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Content-Type` | yes | `application/json` |

### Response body (HTTP 200)

`message`: `Signed in successfully.`  
`data`:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `access_token` | Cognito access token |
| `id_token` | Cognito ID token → use as Bearer `{{id_token}}` |
| `refresh_token` | Refresh token |
| `expires_in` | Seconds until access expires |
| `token_type` | Usually `Bearer` |

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Signed in |
| 400 | Invalid JSON, or missing username/email or password |
| 401 | Invalid credentials / Cognito reject |

### Get my profile

`GET /auth/me/`

Returns the caller's local profile and effective grants. Use this to drive FE nav / permission UI. Any signed-in user (admin not required).

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

**None**.

### Headers

| Header | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | yes | `Authorization: Bearer {{id_token}}` |

### Response body (HTTP 200)

`message`: `Your profile was fetched.`  
`data`: one user object:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Local `rbac_user` PK (`{{user_id}}`) |
| `username` | Cognito / badge username |
| `email` | Optional; null for floor users |
| `display_name` | UI / audit label |
| `photo_url` | Short-lived private S3 URL (`User-profile/{cognito_sub}/…`); null if none |
| `is_active` | Soft-disable flag (synced with Cognito) |
| `is_admin` | `true` if any admin area grant |
| `cognito_sub` | Cognito subject |
| `created_at` | ISO timestamp |
| `departments` | `production` / `warehouse` / `admin` |
| `production_areas` | `low_risk` / `high_risk` / `sleeving` / `dispatch` |
| `warehouse` | `[{ unit, actions, goods_in_periods }]` |
| `admin_areas` | `technical` / `operational` / `npd` / `finance` |

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | OK |
| 401 | Missing/invalid token or no local profile |
| 403 | Account disabled |

formdata.description: JPEG, PNG, or WebP; max 2 MB

request.description:
### Upload my photo

`POST /auth/me/photo/`

Signed-in user uploads their own profile photo. Stored privately in bucket `gazebo-media-files` at `User-profile/{cognito_sub}/photo-{uuid}.{ext}` with SSE-AES256 (no public ACL). Response includes a short-lived presigned `photo_url` (about 1 hour).

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

`multipart/form-data`:

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | yes* | Image file (JPEG / PNG / WebP, max 2 MB) |
| `photo` | yes* | Alias for `file` |

\* Provide `file` **or** `photo`.

### Headers

| Header | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | yes | `Authorization: Bearer {{id_token}}` |
| `Content-Type` | yes | `multipart/form-data` (set by client) |

### Response body (HTTP 200)

`message`: `Photo updated successfully.`  
`data`: user object (same as Get my profile), including:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `photo_url` | Presigned GET for the new object (expires ~1h) |
| `cognito_sub` | Folder key under `User-profile/` |

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Uploaded |
| 400 | Missing file, wrong type, or over 2 MB |
| 401 | Missing/invalid token or no local profile |
| 403 | Account disabled |

item.name: Users & grants
item.description:
Admin Cognito + local profile CRUD and grant replace.

**Tables:** `rbac_user` + grant tables

**Auth:** Bearer + any Admin area grant

**Vars:** `{{user_id}}`

request.description:
### List users

`GET /auth/users/`

Admin list of local profiles with full grant trees. Filter by search text, department membership, or active flag.

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `q` | no | Case-insensitive match on username or display name |
| `department` | no | `production`, `warehouse`, `admin`, or `it` |
| `is_active` | no | `true` / `1` or `false` / `0` |

### Request body

**None**.

### Headers

| Header | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | yes | `Authorization: Bearer {{id_token}}` (admin) |

### Response body (HTTP 200)

`message`: `Users fetched successfully.`  
`data`: array of user objects (same shape as Get user):

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Local `rbac_user` PK (`{{user_id}}`) |
| `username` | Cognito / badge username |
| `email` | Optional; null for floor users |
| `display_name` | UI / audit label |
| `photo_url` | Short-lived private S3 URL (`User-profile/{cognito_sub}/…`); null if none |
| `is_active` | Soft-disable flag (synced with Cognito) |
| `is_admin` | `true` if any admin area grant |
| `cognito_sub` | Cognito subject |
| `created_at` | ISO timestamp |
| `departments` | `production` / `warehouse` / `admin` |
| `production_areas` | `low_risk` / `high_risk` / `sleeving` / `dispatch` |
| `warehouse` | `[{ unit, actions, goods_in_periods }]` |
| `admin_areas` | `technical` / `operational` / `npd` / `finance` |

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | OK |
| 401 | Missing/invalid Bearer token, expired session, or no local profile |
| 403 | Account disabled, or caller has no admin grant |

### Create user

`POST /auth/users/`

Admin creates a Cognito user (no invite email) plus local `rbac_user`. Optional grant payload in the same request. Floor users omit `email`. Writes `user.created` audit.

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `username` | yes | Cognito / badge username |
| `password` | yes | Permanent password (never stored in Django) |
| `email` | no | Office users only |
| `display_name` | no | Audit / UI label |
| `departments` | no | `production`, `warehouse`, `admin`, `it` (global) |
| `production_areas` | no | `low_risk`, `high_risk`, `sleeving`, `dispatch` |
| `warehouse` | no | `[{ unit, actions, goods_in_periods }]` |
| `admin_areas` | no | `technical`, `operational`, `npd`, `finance` |

Production areas require department `production` (same rule for warehouse/admin). Goods IN periods require `goods_in` on that unit.

### Headers

| Header | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | yes | `Authorization: Bearer {{id_token}}` (admin) |
| `Content-Type` | yes | `application/json` |

### Response body (HTTP 201)

`message`: `User created successfully.`  
`data`: full user + grants:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Local `rbac_user` PK (`{{user_id}}`) |
| `username` | Cognito / badge username |
| `email` | Optional; null for floor users |
| `display_name` | UI / audit label |
| `photo_url` | Short-lived private S3 URL (`User-profile/{cognito_sub}/…`); null if none |
| `is_active` | Soft-disable flag (synced with Cognito) |
| `is_admin` | `true` if any admin area grant |
| `cognito_sub` | Cognito subject |
| `created_at` | ISO timestamp |
| `departments` | `production` / `warehouse` / `admin` |
| `production_areas` | `low_risk` / `high_risk` / `sleeving` / `dispatch` |
| `warehouse` | `[{ unit, actions, goods_in_periods }]` |
| `admin_areas` | `technical` / `operational` / `npd` / `finance` |

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 201 | Created |
| 400 | Invalid JSON, missing username/password, bad grants, Cognito password rules |
| 401 | Missing/invalid Bearer token, expired session, or no local profile |
| 403 | Account disabled, or caller has no admin grant |
| 409 | Username or email already in use |

### Get user

`GET /auth/users/:id/`

Admin fetch of one profile and full grant tree.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `rbac_user` primary key (`{{user_id}}`) |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

**None**.

### Headers

| Header | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | yes | `Authorization: Bearer {{id_token}}` (admin) |

### Response body (HTTP 200)

`message`: `User fetched successfully.`  
`data`: user object:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Local `rbac_user` PK (`{{user_id}}`) |
| `username` | Cognito / badge username |
| `email` | Optional; null for floor users |
| `display_name` | UI / audit label |
| `photo_url` | Short-lived private S3 URL (`User-profile/{cognito_sub}/…`); null if none |
| `is_active` | Soft-disable flag (synced with Cognito) |
| `is_admin` | `true` if any admin area grant |
| `cognito_sub` | Cognito subject |
| `created_at` | ISO timestamp |
| `departments` | `production` / `warehouse` / `admin` |
| `production_areas` | `low_risk` / `high_risk` / `sleeving` / `dispatch` |
| `warehouse` | `[{ unit, actions, goods_in_periods }]` |
| `admin_areas` | `technical` / `operational` / `npd` / `finance` |

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | OK |
| 401 | Missing/invalid Bearer token, expired session, or no local profile |
| 403 | Account disabled, or caller has no admin grant |
| 404 | User not found |

### Update user

`PATCH /auth/users/:id/`

Admin updates display name and/or active flag. `is_active` also enables/disables the Cognito user. Writes `user.updated` and/or `user.enabled` / `user.disabled` audit.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `rbac_user` primary key |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `display_name` | no | UI / audit label |
| `is_active` | no | Boolean; syncs Cognito enable/disable |

### Headers

| Header | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | yes | `Authorization: Bearer {{id_token}}` (admin) |
| `Content-Type` | yes | `application/json` |

### Response body (HTTP 200)

`message`: `User updated successfully.`  
`data`: updated user + grants:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Local `rbac_user` PK (`{{user_id}}`) |
| `username` | Cognito / badge username |
| `email` | Optional; null for floor users |
| `display_name` | UI / audit label |
| `photo_url` | Short-lived private S3 URL (`User-profile/{cognito_sub}/…`); null if none |
| `is_active` | Soft-disable flag (synced with Cognito) |
| `is_admin` | `true` if any admin area grant |
| `cognito_sub` | Cognito subject |
| `created_at` | ISO timestamp |
| `departments` | `production` / `warehouse` / `admin` |
| `production_areas` | `low_risk` / `high_risk` / `sleeving` / `dispatch` |
| `warehouse` | `[{ unit, actions, goods_in_periods }]` |
| `admin_areas` | `technical` / `operational` / `npd` / `finance` |

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Updated |
| 400 | Invalid JSON, `is_active` not boolean, Cognito error |
| 401 | Missing/invalid Bearer token, expired session, or no local profile |
| 403 | Account disabled, or caller has no admin grant |
| 404 | User not found |

formdata.description: JPEG, PNG, or WebP; max 2 MB

request.description:
### Upload user photo

`POST /auth/users/:id/photo/`

Admin (any Admin area) or the user themselves uploads a profile photo. Same private S3 layout as Upload my photo: `gazebo-media-files` / `User-profile/{cognito_sub}/…`.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `rbac_user` primary key (`{{user_id}}`) |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

`multipart/form-data`:

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | yes* | Image file (JPEG / PNG / WebP, max 2 MB) |
| `photo` | yes* | Alias for `file` |

\* Provide `file` **or** `photo`.

### Headers

| Header | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | yes | `Authorization: Bearer {{id_token}}` |
| `Content-Type` | yes | `multipart/form-data` (set by client) |

### Response body (HTTP 200)

`message`: `Photo updated successfully.`  
`data`: full user + grants including `photo_url`.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Uploaded |
| 400 | Missing file, wrong type, or over 2 MB |
| 401 | Missing/invalid Bearer token |
| 403 | Not self and no admin grant, or account disabled |
| 404 | User not found |

### Replace grants

`PUT /auth/users/:id/grants/`

Admin idempotent replace of the full grant tree. Missing grant = no access. Writes `grants.replaced` with before/after snapshots.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `rbac_user` primary key |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `departments` | yes | `production`, `warehouse`, `admin`, `it` (global; empty list clears) |
| `production_areas` | yes | Area list (empty ok) |
| `warehouse` | yes | `{ unit, actions, goods_in_periods }` list |
| `admin_areas` | yes | Admin area list (empty ok) |

`unit`: `unit_1`, `unit_2`, `unit_11`.  
`actions`: `goods_in`, `goods_out`.  
`goods_in_periods`: `previous`, `today`, `future` (needs `goods_in`).

### Headers

| Header | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | yes | `Authorization: Bearer {{id_token}}` (admin) |
| `Content-Type` | yes | `application/json` |

### Response body (HTTP 200)

`message`: `User permissions updated.`  
`data`: user + new grants:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Local `rbac_user` PK (`{{user_id}}`) |
| `username` | Cognito / badge username |
| `email` | Optional; null for floor users |
| `display_name` | UI / audit label |
| `photo_url` | Short-lived private S3 URL (`User-profile/{cognito_sub}/…`); null if none |
| `is_active` | Soft-disable flag (synced with Cognito) |
| `is_admin` | `true` if any admin area grant |
| `cognito_sub` | Cognito subject |
| `created_at` | ISO timestamp |
| `departments` | `production` / `warehouse` / `admin` |
| `production_areas` | `low_risk` / `high_risk` / `sleeving` / `dispatch` |
| `warehouse` | `[{ unit, actions, goods_in_periods }]` |
| `admin_areas` | `technical` / `operational` / `npd` / `finance` |

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Replaced |
| 400 | Invalid JSON / unknown values / area without department / periods without goods_in |
| 401 | Missing/invalid Bearer token, expired session, or no local profile |
| 403 | Account disabled, or caller has no admin grant |
| 404 | User not found |

### Reset password

`POST /auth/users/:id/reset-password/`

Admin sets a new permanent Cognito password. Password is never stored in Django or audit JSON. Writes `user.password_reset`.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `rbac_user` primary key |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `password` | yes | New permanent password |

### Headers

| Header | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | yes | `Authorization: Bearer {{id_token}}` (admin) |
| `Content-Type` | yes | `application/json` |

### Response body (HTTP 200)

`message`: `Password was reset.`  
`data`:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ref` | User id |

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Reset |
| 400 | Invalid JSON, missing password, Cognito rejected password |
| 401 | Missing/invalid Bearer token, expired session, or no local profile |
| 403 | Account disabled, or caller has no admin grant |
| 404 | User not found |

item.name: Audit
item.description:
Append-only `rbac_audit_event` history (CloudTrail-style) plus merged Amit-day activity.

**Tables:** `rbac_audit_event`, `stock_entry`, `product_audit`

**Routes:** `GET /auth/audit/`, `GET /auth/users/:id/audit/`, `GET /auth/users/:id/activity/`

**Auth:** Bearer + any Admin area grant

request.description:
### List audit events

`GET /auth/audit/`

Admin CloudTrail-style history of RBAC actions: user create/update/enable/disable, password reset, grant replace, login success/failure. Passwords are never stored.

### Path parameters

None.

### Query parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `actor` | no | Username or cognito `sub` of who did it |
| `target` | no | Username or cognito `sub` of who was affected |
| `action` | no | e.g. `grants.replaced`, `auth.login_success` |
| `from` | no | ISO datetime inclusive |
| `to` | no | ISO datetime inclusive |
| `limit` | no | Default 50, max 200 |
| `offset` | no | Default 0 |

### Request body

**None**.

### Headers

| Header | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | yes | `Authorization: Bearer {{id_token}}` (admin) |

### Response body (HTTP 200)

`message`: `Audit events fetched.`  
`data`:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `items` | Array of audit events |
| `count` | Total matching rows |
| `limit` | Page size used |
| `offset` | Skip used |

Each item:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Event id |
| `at` | ISO timestamp |
| `action` | e.g. `user.created`, `grants.replaced`, `auth.login_success` |
| `actor_sub` / `actor_username` / `actor_display_name` | Who did it |
| `target_user_id` / `target_username` / `target_sub` | Who was affected |
| `request_method` / `request_path` / `request_id` | Request context |
| `source_ip` / `user_agent` | Client info |
| `before_json` / `after_json` | Snapshots (grants / profile) |
| `detail_json` | Extra flags (never passwords) |

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | OK |
| 400 | Bad datetime / `limit` / `offset` |
| 401 | Missing/invalid Bearer token, expired session, or no local profile |
| 403 | Account disabled, or caller has no admin grant |

### User audit timeline

`GET /auth/users/:id/audit/`

Admin timeline for one user. Default `as=target` (what was done to them). `as=actor` = what they did. `as=both` = either.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `rbac_user` primary key |

### Query parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `as` | no | `actor`, `target` (default), or `both` |
| `action` | no | Filter action code |
| `from` / `to` | no | ISO datetime |
| `limit` / `offset` | no | Pagination (default 50 / 0, max 200) |

### Request body

**None**.

### Headers

| Header | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | yes | `Authorization: Bearer {{id_token}}` (admin) |

### Response body (HTTP 200)

`message`: `User audit fetched.`  
`data`: same shape as List audit events (`items`, `count`, `limit`, `offset`).

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | OK |
| 400 | Bad `as` / datetime / pagination |
| 401 | Missing/invalid Bearer token, expired session, or no local profile |
| 403 | Account disabled, or caller has no admin grant |
| 404 | User not found |

### User activity

`GET /auth/users/:id/activity/`

Admin merged timeline of what this user did: RBAC events (login, denials, grant changes they made) plus stock entries and product audit hits keyed by their `cognito_sub` / username. Newest first. Use this for “what did amit01 do after login?”.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `rbac_user` primary key (`{{user_id}}`) |

### Query parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `from` | no | ISO datetime inclusive |
| `to` | no | ISO datetime inclusive |
| `limit` | no | Default 50, max 200 |
| `offset` | no | Default 0 |

### Request body

**None**.

### Headers

| Header | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | yes | `Authorization: Bearer {{id_token}}` (admin) |

### Response body (HTTP 200)

`message`: `User activity fetched.`  
`data`:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `items` | Merged events, newest first |
| `count` | Total matching rows |
| `limit` | Page size used |
| `offset` | Skip used |

Each item:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | `rbac`, `stock`, or `product` |
| `at` | ISO timestamp |
| `action` | RBAC action, stock entry type, or product action |
| `actor_sub` / `actor_username` / `lan_username` | Who (when present) |
| `product_id` / `entry_id` / `request_path` | Domain pointers |
| `source_ip` | Client IP when known |

RBAC items also include the full audit event fields (`before_json`, `after_json`, `detail_json`, …).

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | OK |
| 400 | Bad datetime / `limit` / `offset` |
| 401 | Missing/invalid Bearer token, expired session, or no local profile |
| 403 | Account disabled, or caller has no admin grant |
| 404 | User not found |
